backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor serving as the backend canister placeholder with no methods defined.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting the fix for the 3x3 sliding tile puzzle image rendering in PuzzleMinigame.tsx, with test ID REQ-6 and high confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-line summaries of each frontend source file for documentation or build planning purposes.
frontend/index.css: Empty CSS file at the frontend root level.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Valentine app, mounting the React app at the root div and loading main.tsx as a module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that sets up TanStack Router with three routes (Home, ValentineMessage, PuzzleMinigame) wrapped in a shared Layout component.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Shared layout component rendering animated floating hearts in the background, wrapping page content, and displaying a footer with caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using TanStack Query, supporting both anonymous and authenticated (Internet Identity) usage.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Custom hook and context provider managing Internet Identity authentication state, including login, logout, and identity persistence via AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder module exporting nothing, noting that no backend queries are needed for this static Valentine app.
frontend/src/hooks/useSlidingPuzzle.ts: Custom hook managing 3x3 sliding puzzle state, including solvability-checked shuffle, tile move validation, move counting, and completion detection.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet defining a pink OKLCH Valentine color system, Comic Sans font, reusable Valentine UI component classes, and keyframe animations for hearts and modals.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that wraps the App component with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider before mounting to the DOM.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Landing page displaying a Valentine banner image, a greeting card for Aika Rienasari, and navigation buttons to the message and puzzle pages.
frontend/src/pages/PuzzleMinigame.tsx: Renders a 3x3 sliding tile puzzle page using the couple's AYCE photo, displaying move count, solved status, and tile grid with click-to-move interaction via the useSlidingPuzzle hook.
frontend/src/pages/ValentineMessage.tsx: Displays a Valentine's Day message page with the couple's AYCE photo, a romantic love letter, and a navigation button to the puzzle minigame.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the theme with Comic Sans font, pink box shadows, oklch-based color tokens, and accordion keyframes, with typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks the current project state (version 5) for a Valentine app, listing existing features, architectural notes (pink theme, Comic Sans), and a known issue with puzzle tile image rendering.
